measurements.plant_part: flower heads and leafy flowering stems
measurements.origin: Natural Park of Montesinho territory, Trás-os-Montes, North-eastern Portugal
measurements.equipment: Hewlett-Packard 1100, Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, USA) as previously described by the authors (Barros et al., 2012). Double online detection was carried out in the diode array detector (DAD) using 280 nm and 370 nm as preferred wavelengths and in a mass spectrometer (MS) connected to the HPLC system via the DAD cell outlet
